To lower the entry barrier and reduce loss concerns when trading on the Prediction Market, Zoomex is launching the exclusive Prediction Market "Loss-Protection Voucher". This voucher is a loss-coverage perk; it is not cash and cannot be used to pay for order amounts. Below are the detailed usage instructions for the Prediction Market Loss-Protection Voucher.
What is the Prediction Market Loss-Protection Voucher?

The Prediction Market Loss-Protection Voucher is a loss-protection perk. You must claim it first and enable "Loss Protection" when opening a buy position. Orders are still paid using your own available balance. When the position closes (upon market settlement/redemption or full sale of holdings) and incurs an actual loss, the platform will compensate the actual loss—up to your available voucher quota—into your UTA withdrawable balance. Profits or break-even outcomes do not trigger compensation.

Whether a position is protected is determined by the setting at the time of the first filled buy order for that position, and cannot be toggled on or off afterward. Subsequent additions to the same prediction event inherit the same protection setting, and the added amounts are included in the overall position PnL calculation.
Voucher Types
Prediction Market Loss-Protection Vouchers can only be used in the Prediction Market and currently include the following two mechanisms:
Voucher
How to Claim
Function
First-Order Loss-Protection Voucher
Click "Claim" in the "Rewards Hub" or the pending-claim bar on the Prediction Market homepage; issued to the Main Account
One-time coverage: Only compensates the realized loss of the first closed position after claiming, up to the remaining quota; any remaining quota expires once that first position closes.
Quota Loss-Protection Voucher
Same as above
Multi-use within quota: Compensates realized losses upon the closure of each protected position until the quota is exhausted or the voucher expires.
All Prediction Market Loss-Protection Vouchers are subject to the following rules
Valid only for Prediction Market orders; cannot be used for Futures, Copy Trading, or other services.
Cannot replace available balance for payments; order amounts (including trading fees) must be paid with the user's own funds.
Cannot be directly withdrawn, gifted, transferred, or exchanged for other assets under any circumstances; credited compensation funds are deposited into the UTA withdrawable balance.
Applicable to all supported prediction products and markets on the platform (subject to event and voucher face details).
Only Main Accounts are eligible to claim and use vouchers.
Each voucher has a claim deadline and a post-claim validity period; any remaining quota will be reclaimed and voided upon expiration.
Coverage Scope & Core Rules
Position Definition

Position: A single position cycle is defined as the same user on the same prediction market (event). Both "Yes" and "No" directions are combined for calculation to prevent simultaneous two-way hedging to exploit compensation.
How Realized Loss is Calculated

Upon position closure: Realized Loss = max(0, Total Filled Buy Amount − Total Sell Proceeds − Settlement Payout). Trading fees are excluded from the loss calculation. Partial sales do not trigger compensation; calculation occurs only after the entire position is closed.
Compensation Timing & Amount
Trigger Condition: The position cycle closes and the Realized Loss is greater than 0.

Compensation Amount: min(Realized Loss, Total Available Voucher Quota). If multiple vouchers are held, they are deducted sequentially in the order they were claimed. Cumulative compensation for a single position will not exceed its Realized Loss.

Effective Coverage: Applies to active Prediction Loss-Protection Vouchers claimed prior to opening the position with a remaining quota greater than 0. Vouchers claimed after opening a position will not protect that position.

Crediting: After passing risk control review, compensation is transferred from the platform's financial payout account to your UTA withdrawable balance, recorded under the UTA transaction type "Prediction Loss Compensation".
Risk Control Rejection: No compensation will be issued, and the voucher quota will not be deducted.
Deductions & Non-Compensation Scenarios
Vouchers cannot be used as order margin or to offset buy trading fees.
Position closes in profit or break-even: No compensation is issued, and the quota remains unchanged.
Order canceled, rejected, or zero-filled: No position is opened, and the voucher remains unaffected.
Full refund due to market anomaly: Loss is 0; no compensation is issued, and the voucher remains unaffected.
Voucher expires before position closes: Unrealized losses are not covered, and the expired voucher will not be used when the position eventually closes.
How to Use the Loss-Protection Voucher
Step
Description
Issuance
Upon completing event tasks or targeted issuance, the voucher enters the "Rewards Hub" as pending claim. Issuance does not equal activation; it cannot be used until claimed.
Claiming
Go to "Rewards Hub" › "My Rewards", or the pending-claim bar on the Prediction Market homepage, and click "Claim". Once claimed, the quota activates immediately without transfers or entering UTA.
Viewing
Check remaining quota, expiration time, and compensation records under "My Vouchers" on the Prediction Market homepage, or under "Claimed" in the Rewards Hub.
Using

"Enable Loss Protection" is checked by default on the buy order panel, displaying "Max Coverage". You may uncheck it, but it cannot be enabled after opening the position. No manual selection of specific vouchers is needed; the system automatically deducts them in claim order upon compensation.
Holding
Protected positions display a "Loss Protection" tag; estimated max coverage can be viewed in My Orders.
Compensation

When a position closes at a loss: Status initially shows "Compensation Processing". Once credited, your UTA withdrawable balance increases, and both the order and voucher timelines update to "Credited".

The "Max Coverage" shown when placing an order is an estimate calculated as min(Total Filled Buy Amount of This Position, Total Available Quota for This Position). If multiple open protected positions exist simultaneously, they share the quota, which is deducted in the order positions close; actual compensation is determined when each position closes.
Usage Order for Multiple Vouchers
If an account holds multiple eligible Prediction Market Loss-Protection Vouchers, the system deducts them upon position closure in the following order:
First-Order Position: First-Order Loss-Protection Vouchers are used first, followed by Quota Loss-Protection Vouchers.
Non-First-Order Positions: Only Quota Loss-Protection Vouchers are used.
Vouchers of the same type are used sequentially from earliest to latest claim time.

If a single voucher's remaining quota is insufficient to cover the entire loss of the position, the next eligible voucher will be used until the loss is fully covered or all available quotas are exhausted.

A user holds one 10 USDT First-Order Loss-Protection Voucher and one Quota Loss-Protection Voucher with 20 USDT remaining. When their first protected position closes with a realized loss of 25 USDT, the system first uses the First-Order Voucher to compensate 10 USDT, and then uses the Quota Voucher to compensate 15 USDT. The First-Order Voucher is settled and voided, while the Quota Voucher retains 5 USDT for future positions.
Validity, Claiming & Expiration
Claim Deadline
Must be claimed before the configured claim deadline; unclaimed vouchers expire afterward.
Usage Validity
Calculated from the exact second the voucher is successfully claimed (typically 7 days; subject to voucher face details).
Expiration
Remaining quota is voided and reclaimed; compensation already accepted and in transfer will still be credited.
Reclamation & Voiding
Trigger Scenario
Full compensation paid or first-order position settled
Voucher is settled, and any remaining quota is voided.
Position closes in profit with no compensation triggered
Voucher remains active until its usage validity period expires, then becomes void.
Quota Loss-Protection Voucher quota fully depleted
Voucher is settled.
Usage validity period expires
Remaining quota of that voucher is reclaimed.
Unclaimed past the claim deadline
Pending-claim voucher becomes invalid.
Checking Usage Records
Voucher & Compensation Progress
"My Vouchers" on Prediction Market Homepage: View active, settled, and expired vouchers; click a voucher card to check issuance, claim, compensation, and usage timestamps.
Rewards Hub "My Rewards": Unclaimed and claimed data sync directly with "My Vouchers".
My Orders › Top "Loss Protection Quota" Data Card: Quickly view total currently available compensation quota.
"Loss Protection" Tag in Positions or Settled List: View the compensation status, realized loss, and breakdown for that specific position.
Fund Crediting
In UTA Transaction History, records under the type "Prediction Loss Compensation" represent credited compensation amounts (displayed only after crediting; processing items do not appear in history).
1. Why didn't I receive compensation after incurring a loss?

Possible reasons include: Loss Protection was not enabled when opening the position; the voucher expired before the position closed; the quota was used up by other protected positions that closed earlier; the position was not your first order while you only held a First-Order Voucher; or the payout failed risk control review. Please click the "Loss Protection" tag in My Orders to view the status and details.
2. Can I place orders using only the Loss-Protection Voucher without depositing funds?
No. Loss-Protection Vouchers cannot be used for payments; you must use your own available balance to place orders.
3. How long does it take for compensation to arrive?

It is typically processed within a few minutes after the position closes. Status shows "Compensation Processing" during review, and updates to "Credited" in both the order list and transaction history once deposited.
4. Can I manually specify which voucher to use?

No. Loss compensation is automatically deducted by the system in voucher priority order: First-Order Vouchers (for first-order positions only) take priority, followed by Quota Vouchers, ordered from earliest to latest claim time within the same type.
5. Can I receive compensation if I buy both Yes and No simultaneously?

Both directions within the same market are combined into a single position, and compensation is calculated solely based on the combined realized loss. If the combined position incurs no loss, no compensation is triggered.

1. Prediction Market Loss-Protection Vouchers are promotional platform rewards and do not constitute investment advice or guaranteed returns. Prediction trading carries high risk, and you may incur losses exceeding your voucher quota.

2. Voucher face values, validity periods, types, eligible recipients, and usage rules are subject to the voucher details, these rules, and the terms published on the event page. Compensation amounts, estimated max coverage, and position PnL are governed by Zoomex system records.

3. Engaging in any dishonest behavior—such as multi-account registration, wash trading, intentionally generating losses to fraudulently claim compensation, or two-way hedging within the same market to exploit payouts—will result in immediate termination, forfeiture of vouchers and issued rewards on the relevant accounts, and potential denial of compensation.

4. Zoomex reserves the final right to modify the terms, conditions, and event rules of the Prediction Market Loss-Protection Voucher without prior notice. Users are advised to review the latest terms and conditions regularly. Where separate event rules apply, the event page shall prevail.

To lower the entry barrier and reduce loss concerns when trading on the Prediction Market, Zoomex is launching the exclusive Prediction Market "Loss-Protection Voucher". This voucher is a loss-coverage perk; it is not cash and cannot be used to pay for order amounts. Below are the detailed usage instructions for the Prediction Market Loss-Protection Voucher.
What is the Prediction Market Loss-Protection Voucher?

The Prediction Market Loss-Protection Voucher is a loss-protection perk. You must claim it first and enable "Loss Protection" when opening a buy position. Orders are still paid using your own available balance. When the position closes (upon market settlement/redemption or full sale of holdings) and incurs an actual loss, the platform will compensate the actual loss—up to your available voucher quota—into your UTA withdrawable balance. Profits or break-even outcomes do not trigger compensation.

Whether a position is protected is determined by the setting at the time of the first filled buy order for that position, and cannot be toggled on or off afterward. Subsequent additions to the same prediction event inherit the same protection setting, and the added amounts are included in the overall position PnL calculation.

Coverage Scope & Core Rules
Position Definition

Position: A single position cycle is defined as the same user on the same prediction market (event). Both "Yes" and "No" directions are combined for calculation to prevent simultaneous two-way hedging to exploit compensation.
How Realized Loss is Calculated

Upon position closure: Realized Loss = max(0, Total Filled Buy Amount − Total Sell Proceeds − Settlement Payout). Trading fees are excluded from the loss calculation. Partial sales do not trigger compensation; calculation occurs only after the entire position is closed.
Compensation Timing & Amount
Trigger Condition: The position cycle closes and the Realized Loss is greater than 0.

Compensation Amount: min(Realized Loss, Total Available Voucher Quota). If multiple vouchers are held, they are deducted sequentially in the order they were claimed. Cumulative compensation for a single position will not exceed its Realized Loss.

Effective Coverage: Applies to active Prediction Loss-Protection Vouchers claimed prior to opening the position with a remaining quota greater than 0. Vouchers claimed after opening a position will not protect that position.

Crediting: After passing risk control review, compensation is transferred from the platform's financial payout account to your UTA withdrawable balance, recorded under the UTA transaction type "Prediction Loss Compensation".
Risk Control Rejection: No compensation will be issued, and the voucher quota will not be deducted.
Deductions & Non-Compensation Scenarios
Vouchers cannot be used as order margin or to offset buy trading fees.
Position closes in profit or break-even: No compensation is issued, and the quota remains unchanged.
Order canceled, rejected, or zero-filled: No position is opened, and the voucher remains unaffected.
Full refund due to market anomaly: Loss is 0; no compensation is issued, and the voucher remains unaffected.
Voucher expires before position closes: Unrealized losses are not covered, and the expired voucher will not be used when the position eventually closes.

The "Max Coverage" shown when placing an order is an estimate calculated as min(Total Filled Buy Amount of This Position, Total Available Quota for This Position). If multiple open protected positions exist simultaneously, they share the quota, which is deducted in the order positions close; actual compensation is determined when each position closes.
Usage Order for Multiple Vouchers
If an account holds multiple eligible Prediction Market Loss-Protection Vouchers, the system deducts them upon position closure in the following order:
First-Order Position: First-Order Loss-Protection Vouchers are used first, followed by Quota Loss-Protection Vouchers.
Non-First-Order Positions: Only Quota Loss-Protection Vouchers are used.
Vouchers of the same type are used sequentially from earliest to latest claim time.

If a single voucher's remaining quota is insufficient to cover the entire loss of the position, the next eligible voucher will be used until the loss is fully covered or all available quotas are exhausted.

A user holds one 10 USDT First-Order Loss-Protection Voucher and one Quota Loss-Protection Voucher with 20 USDT remaining. When their first protected position closes with a realized loss of 25 USDT, the system first uses the First-Order Voucher to compensate 10 USDT, and then uses the Quota Voucher to compensate 15 USDT. The First-Order Voucher is settled and voided, while the Quota Voucher retains 5 USDT for future positions.

1. Why didn't I receive compensation after incurring a loss?

Possible reasons include: Loss Protection was not enabled when opening the position; the voucher expired before the position closed; the quota was used up by other protected positions that closed earlier; the position was not your first order while you only held a First-Order Voucher; or the payout failed risk control review. Please click the "Loss Protection" tag in My Orders to view the status and details.
2. Can I place orders using only the Loss-Protection Voucher without depositing funds?
No. Loss-Protection Vouchers cannot be used for payments; you must use your own available balance to place orders.
3. How long does it take for compensation to arrive?

It is typically processed within a few minutes after the position closes. Status shows "Compensation Processing" during review, and updates to "Credited" in both the order list and transaction history once deposited.
4. Can I manually specify which voucher to use?

No. Loss compensation is automatically deducted by the system in voucher priority order: First-Order Vouchers (for first-order positions only) take priority, followed by Quota Vouchers, ordered from earliest to latest claim time within the same type.
5. Can I receive compensation if I buy both Yes and No simultaneously?

Both directions within the same market are combined into a single position, and compensation is calculated solely based on the combined realized loss. If the combined position incurs no loss, no compensation is triggered.
